dominant_strengths: Editorial serif headline pairs unexpectedly well with sans body, giving the destructive modal weight and gravitas
Restrained red-on-near-black palette with tinted warning panel creates clear danger semantics without screaming
Hierarchy is clean: icon, title, subtext, bulleted consequences, then twin actions in correct visual weight
dominant_weaknesses: Layout is a textbook destructive-confirmation modal—nothing structurally novel beyond Linear/Vercel conventions
Glow under the Delete button is slightly heavy and competes with the warning panel for attention
Missing friction safeguard (typed confirmation, undo timer) for an action explicitly described as irreversible
fix_priorities: Add a typed-name confirmation field to match the 'cannot be undone' copy and elevate trust
Tone down the red button bloom or remove it so the warning tint panel reads as the danger anchor
Tighten vertical rhythm between title and bullet card; the gap currently feels slightly loose
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral and behavioral are well-tuned via clear danger color and obvious primary action, but reflective depth is thin because the irreversibility claim isn't backed by a real safety mechanism.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes—it executes the destructive-modal brief competently and legibly, just without inventing anything beyond the established pattern.
